content.scenario: A consumer wants to refer to the new consumer protection law in a complaint. They are unsure what to call the statute.
content.outcome: The consumer can refer to the statute as the 'Consumer Protection Act, 2019', as per Section 1 of the Act. This is the official short title of the statute.
